top_issues: Legend colors (green/violet) at the bottom of the balance bar are small and not colorblind-safe in isolation
"Show 1 empty" link below Balances is cryptic and reads like a broken control
Balance bars sit on a near-black background — the 1px grey bar track is hard to see without zoom
fixes: Add text labels or patterns next to each legend swatch (not color alone)
Rename "Show 1 empty" to "Show 1 empty asset" or drop it
Raise the bar-track contrast from near-black to a visible grey

top_issues: "Provable" panel uses nested protocol language ("frame", "bilateral", "collateral") that a first-timer won't parse
Before/After "115.00 owes you" bar labels are right-aligned and easy to misread as a balance change rather than a limit
Route panel shows atomic H1→H2 but no hint of the alternative route's cost
fixes: Add a one-line plain-English gloss to the Provable card ("both sides sign, so it can't be changed")
Prefix limit labels with "H1 credit limit: ..." to avoid ambiguity
Under the route, show the other route's fee delta in one line

top_issues: "Verified by your runtime" uses jargon — "runtime" means nothing to a first-time user
"in 8s" and "#61" are small and easy to miss for someone forwarding proof
"Proof" value is a raw hash with no explanatory label of what it proves
fixes: Rename to "Verified by your device" or add tooltip "verifies it can't be altered"
Increase the settled-duration and frame-number font size one step
Label the hash as "Proof (frame hash)" and add "copy" affordance

top_issues: The "Note" textarea placeholder "What is this for?" reads as an unfinished template, not a designed input
"25.50 capacity via H1" is unexplained — a payer can't tell if that's their limit or the recipient's
The QR is enormous relative to the amount field, wasting vertical space and pushing the note off-fold
fixes: Replace placeholder with a real label "Add a note (visible to payer)"
Annotate the capacity line: "H1 can receive up to 25.50 into this account"
Scale the QR to ~200px and reflow the amount/account fields into view

top_issues: Order-book colors (orange asks / green bids) are not colorblind-safe — a red-green deficit user sees two identical tones
"live relay" status chip is unexplained jargon
The bid/ask table has no volume axis, so "30.6000" conveys size without a visual anchor
fixes: Add tick labels or direction chevrons (▲/▼) to the bid/ask rows
Rename "live relay" to "live prices" or add a tooltip
Add a right-side volume rail so size reads visually

top_issues: The floating tooltip "Account opening requested with zero credit. Prepare incoming capacity after confirmation." overlaps the slider and reads as an error, not guidance
Three collateral toggles (100/50/0%) plus "Extend credit limit" and a fee panel create a wall of decisions
"Legs" (1 Testnet / 2 Tron / 0 Clear) is opaque — a cross-border user can't see the one number they care about (total fee)
fixes: Move the zero-credit note into a dedicated info strip, not an overlapping tooltip
Collapse collateral choice into a single selector with a short explainer
Show "Total fee: X USDC" as one prominent line above the legs

top_issues: The red "Dispute" button is visually loud and makes an ordinary account look adversarial
"They owe you uncovered $90.00" vs "Covered by collateral $0.00" is the key risk signal but the small legend at top is easy to miss
"Frames signed: 15" is cryptic — a user can't tell what a frame is without reading the card text
fixes: De-emphasize Dispute to a secondary outline button (keep red only as a hover state)
Move the uncovered/covered risk line into a highlighted "Risk" summary box
Label as "Signed frames (15)" or "15 agreements signed" and keep the explainer adjacent

top_issues: The right-hand detail panel is mostly empty when nothing is selected, wasting half the viewport
"2 committed entries" on the detail card uses protocol jargon
Filter pills (All/Payments/Swaps/Settlement/Accounts) are ambigious — "Settlement" vs "Payments" overlap for most users
fixes: Auto-select the first item or show a hint placeholder in the detail panel
Rename to "2 signed entries" or "2 records"
Add one-line descriptions to the filters or replace "Settlement" with "Transfer"

top_issues: This frame is visually identical to 07-activity.png — it does not provide a distinct "detail" view
"Payment - Settled" label and hash/proof are fine but duplicate the receipt modal content instead of adding a forwardable statement
No export or copy path in the detail panel itself (only the top-level Export CSV)
fixes: Make the detail panel a richer single-transaction statement (to/from, route, fee, proof, copy button)
Add a "Copy as text" action inside the detail card so a user can forward proof without opening CSV
Differentiate 08 from 07 by expanding the detail pane content

top_issues: "1 px = $1" as the bar-scale unit is confusing — users think in dollars, not pixels
The Material/Accent/Numbers/Risk section is a large set of near-identical pills, high cognitive load
Some toggles (On-chain wallet / Reserve / Accounts) lack a consequence hint, so users can't predict what switching off does
fixes: Clarify as "1 bar-width = $1" or show an explicit ratio next to the sample bar
Group the appearance selectors into fewer, taller options with previews
Add a one-line "what this disables" under each toggle

top_issues: "Recipient entity" header uses "entity" for what a layperson calls a wallet/account
"Add to batch" is shown alongside the primary action without explaining what a batch is
The "What happens" explainer is text-only and easy to skip
fixes: Rename "Recipient entity" to "Recipient account" for clarity
Add a one-line tooltip: "Batch = sign several moves at once"
Make the "What happens" a labeled illustration or keep it but add an icon

top_issues: "Where your money stands" repeats the Home legend but the "Promised by hubs $90.00" vs "Yours whatever a hub does $40.00" phrasing is the strongest trust signal yet buried in a small card
"Needs attention: Nothing waiting on you" is good but reads slightly dismissive for a risk view
The top action cards (Sovereignty/Move/Assets/Lending/Ownership) have no hierarchy — all equal weight
fixes: Promote the "Where your money stands" card near the top and enlarge the numbers
Keep the empty-state but add "check returns" or "review" affordance
Differentiate primary actions from secondary via weight or accent

top_issues: The 100%/50%/0% collateral slider sits on top of overlapping labels and the drag handle is tiny
Two purple buttons ("Extend credit limit" and "Receive USDC from H1") compete for the primary action
The faucet section is testnet-only yet displayed without a warning that it's a dev tool
fixes: Separate the collateral slider from the labels and enlarge the handle
Make one clear primary action and de-emphasize the other as outline
Add a "Testnet only — not for real funds" banner over the faucet

top_issues: "Interest you ask: 100" with "= 100% per term" is mathematically wrong or at least confusing — 100 basis points is 1%, not 100%, which undermines trust in the pool math
Pool stats (Available/Borrowed/Active principal) are all 0.00 with no explanation of what causes them to move
The "Offer to the pool" action has no risk disclosure about principal loss
fixes: Fix the interest display to "= 1.00% per term" or label the input as basis points explicitly
Add a one-line "what changes these numbers" note
Add a risk line: "You can lose principal if the hub defaults" under the lend action

top_issues: The screen is mostly empty — a single board card (Threshold 1 of 1) leaves the right column blank
"Self-issued (its id is the hash of its board)" is dense governance jargon with no plain-English gloss
"Take control of another entity" has no entry affordance — it's a dead-end empty state
fixes: Add a provenance/rotation history list to fill the right column
Gloss as "one signer owns this wallet today; you can add more", then keep the hash detail
Provide a search or "connect entity" input instead of a bare empty state

top_issues: "Enforceable right now $40.00" headline is good, but the "$90.00 at risk" for H1 is a small card with no context for how $90 at risk arises from $40 enforceable
"Co-signed" and "co-signed proof on file" use jargon
"Ledger" section lists Runtime/Frame/Jurisdiction — a user can't tell the difference between these without domain knowledge
fixes: Add a one-line bridge: "$90 is what H1 owes you on its promise; $40 is already secured"
Gloss "co-signed" as "signed by both sides"
Add an icon or tooltip to each ledger row

top_issues: The account-lane table is extremely dense (9 columns) — it's superb for a power user but unusable for a novice
Two order books display almost identically with no caption distinguishing ask vs bid color
Small text (1px = $1) and column headers strain legibility at 100% zoom
fixes: Add a column-collapse toggle for non-operator users
Differentiate the ask/bid visual treatment (add ▲/▼ or a midline gap)
Increase base type size one step or add a density toggle

top_issues: The palette overlay dims the whole desk but keeps the order book crisp, which is visually noisy behind the menu
The list only reaches `Lending` — there's no obvious entry for "dispute", which Kenji needs
Section hint text is tiny relative to the large command labels
fixes: Flatten/darken the background more behind the overlay
Add a "Dispute" entry to the command list
Increase the hint-text size one step

overall.verdict: A genuinely strong, cohesive dark desktop wallet that leads with an unusually good education layer (color-coded risk bars, "How to read this", provable-payment receipts) and a clean power-user desk. It loses points to heavy protocol jargon, one wrong-looking interest figure in Lending, no mobile variants, and the absence of dedicated invoice and dispute-verification screens that several personas need.
priority_fixes: Add a dedicated Invoice create/view screen (Sofia) and show cross-chain swaps as one clear total fee (Fatima).
Add mobile/light variants — the submission is desktop-dark only (Lena cannot be validated).
Fix the Lending interest readout: 100 basis points must display "= 1.00% per term", not "= 100% per term" (trust + data legibility).
Replace/gloss jargon on first-run surfaces ("runtime", "frame", "lane", "entity", "co-signed") with plain equivalents plus one-line tooltips (Maya, Dmitri, Ravi).
Add a dispute-flow screen with a live challenge-window countdown and per-frame evidence list, and de-emphasize the red Dispute button on the Account screen (Kenji).

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: I could get money in and pay a friend $20, but I kept meeting “runtime”, “frame” and “entity” words I had to skip.
blockers: "How to read this" is great, but the violet “Promised” concept and the Accounts/H1 wiring on Home is jargon
"Show 1 empty" under Balances is confusing
"Verified by your runtime" on the receipt is meaningless to a beginner

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: In about 20 seconds I saw credit vs collateral and my uncovered risk on the Account screen — that's what I needed.
blockers: "They owe you uncovered $90.00" and the risk legend are small and easy to miss
Inbound/outbound capacity is labeled “send up to / receive up to” rather than the Lightning terms I expected

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: The swap has a real order book with live prices and a limit price, but the book is one line deep and the fee math is spread across panels.
blockers: Order book is very thin — no depth, no candlesticks
“Hub fee” and “lot rounding” are new terms without tooltips
History lives in Activity under a “Swaps” filter but fills aren't itemized

personas.name: Ravi
personas.verdict: I could see what's enforceable right now (Sovereignty) and export CSV plus an evidence bundle — but I'd want a cleaner board-statement export.
blockers: On-chain enforceability is well shown, but there's no single downloadable statement beyond CSV and a raw bundle
“Committed frames” jargon needs a plain gloss for a board audience

personas.name: Sofia
personas.verdict: I can send a payment link and forward a receipt PDF, but there is no real invoice I can create, number, and track.
blockers: No invoice creation screen exists in the set
The Receive note field says “What is this for?” instead of prompting an invoice/description
Receipt is a modal, not a forwardable branded statement

personas.name: Kenji
personas.verdict: The evidence bundle and frame hashes are there, and the Account screen even points me to Dispute — but I never see the actual dispute flow.
blockers: No dispute-detail screen with a challenge-window countdown
“5 co-signed / 15 frames” is a count, not a per-frame evidence list
The Dispute button is red and loud but the verification view is buried

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: I can't judge this — every shot is a big desktop screen, and I only use my phone one-handed.
blockers: No mobile or responsive screenshots provided; entire set is desktop-dark
Can't verify the 10-second one-hand checkout
Thin tap targets and dense tables suggest mobile would be cramped

personas.name: Marcus
personas.verdict: The Desk and Account views let me read a counterparty's exposure and collateral at a glance — that's exactly my job.
blockers: Desk table is superb but lacks a per-lane drill-down and historical exposure trend
Order books are thin; no depth-of-book view

personas.name: Fatima
personas.verdict: I see the USDT route from Testnet to Tron, but the fee isn't one number and the “legs” framing is confusing.
blockers: No single “Total fee” figure — it's spread across “1 bps” and gross-receive notes
“Legs” and “atomic” language is opaque
The zero-credit warning on 05b reads like an error and adds anxiety

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: In three minutes I understood the core idea (money either on-chain, in reserve, or backed by a hub that can dispute), but the jargon and one bad interest figure make me pause.
blockers: “Runtime”, “frame”, “lane”, “co-signed” require domain knowledge
Lending shows “= 100% per term” for 100 basis points, which looks like a bug and hurts credibility
The differentiation message isn't stated as one crisp sentence anywhere
